blends.name: Ancient Spaceship A
blends.desc:
Ancient Spaceship A
ARK GENESIS (Mythic)

Rending the surface, this macro-ship is capable of extracting energy from the core of a planet with its terrifying tentacles. Once the job is done, all life is annihilated under the shadow of Ark Genesis, leaving only a barren and uninhabitable wasteland where only steam and desolation will remain.

blends.name: Ancient Spaceship B
blends.desc:
Ancient Spaceship B
CALYPSO (Legendary)

Through an electromagnetic field generated by its large luminous reactor, Calypso immobilizes all life wherever it lands, while its crew can steal and extract materials and resources from the planet's inhabitants. They will only be able to see paralyzed and horrified how all their belongings, supplies and technology are stolen, feeling the impotence of not being able to do anything.

blends.name: Ancient Spaceship C
blends.desc:
Ancient Spaceship C
STAR HUNTER (Epic)

Equipped with a camouflage shield, the Star Hunter can be invisible to any eye or radar. This is very useful to investigate small colonies without being located and fall on them when they least expect it to extract any type of technology that can be of great use to us. The Star Hunter is also capable of scraping small amounts of energy from the surface of small stars which it will store in its vast storehouse.
